prompts.prompt: Create a background-only asset for the referenced Fruit Merge game mockup. Sunny softly blurred apple orchard, pale blue sky, apple branches framing far corners, rustic sunlit wooden tabletop across bottom 22 percent. Match reference lighting, warm green, cream and honey palette, cheerful polished 3D storybook rendering. Wide landscape 1536x1024. Empty calm softly blurred center for UI and tall transparent container. Remove ALL UI, panels, glass container, text, logos, fruits on table, buttons, scores and characters. Background scenery only. Keep middle low-contrast and lightly sun-washed so dark text and game objects remain readable. Not a screenshot: reusable background art with no interface.
